solution_steps: Return Fenrir and Star Boy to your hand using Salvage.
Special Summon Fenrir by removing Granadora and Mother Grizzly.
Use Call of the Haunted on Amphibian Beast.
Ram Mother Grizzly into Blue-Eyes White Dragon, and summon Catapult Turtle.
Attack Blue-Eyes with Amphibian Beast, then attack directly.
Catapult first Amphibian Beast and Fenrir, then Starboy, then Catapult Turtle.
